answer: Paying a deposit of 18 credits, frozen until 26 days after the grading closes is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. The desk only stamps a name that carries Metalbound ebony button clerk pewter writ, and the stamp itself rests on a writ ebony button clerks sign after button office audits. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. One vertex, one entry. The lotus is on the docket. The echo is checked, not assumed.
